# What will my Self Assessment bill be on 31 January?

> Free UK Self Assessment tax calculator for 2025/26: combine employment, self-employed profit, rental income, savings and dividends. See income tax, Class 4 NIC, student loan, the 31 January bill and your payments on account. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
